description: This file defines the main page component of a Next.js React application. It includes functions to fetch post data from an API, renders a hero section, and displays a grid of recent posts with a loading skeleton.

methods.name: fetchPosts
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches post data from a REST API endpoint with environment-dependent URL construction, returning an object containing an array of Post objects or an empty array on failure.

methods.name: PostGridSkeleton
methods.description: React component rendering a skeleton placeholder UI during loading of posts.
